paketi.title:
A clear price for the build,
a clear price for the upkeep.
paketi.p1: We don't just build a website. We help your business become visible where your future clients are already looking — on Google.
paketi.p2: The build is paid once, and you know the price before we start. Maintenance is a separate, agreed amount — hosting, security, updates and small content changes are all part of it. No hourly billing, no invoices that catch you off guard.
paketi.note: Extra pages, an online store, bookings, online payment, AI agents and other features are available as your business needs them.
